entry:done.description: A card may only enter Done after the outcome has been verified independently — by a second person, or by the same person after a deliberate pause.
entry:done.message: Card has not been verified. Done requires independent acceptance.

entry:review.description: All acceptance criteria must be met, from the worker's perspective, before a card enters Review.
entry:review.message: Card is not ready for Review — confirm every acceptance criterion is met.

no-pullback.description: Cards must not move backward through the value stream. If rework is needed, add a note to the card explaining why.
no-pullback.message: Moving a card backward hides rework. Add a note to the card explaining why instead.

wip-limit.description: A column must not hold more cards than its wip_limit.
wip-limit.message: Moving this card would exceed the WIP limit. Stop starting, start finishing.
